No two consecutive words can share the same first letter. Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a fish being pulled out of the water by a human and made to stare at the solar eclipse. The fish descends into a lovecraftian monologue about "horrors beyond it's comprehension" and has an existensial crisisassistant
response:
FADE IN:

EXT. BEACH - DAY

The sun beats down on the sandy shore as a human, JEN (30s), wades into the ocean, her eyes scanning the water for signs of life. She spots a fish, FINLEY (a sleek, silver fish), swimming near the surface. With a swift motion, she scoops up Finley in her net and pulls him out of the water.

JEN
(excitedly)
Oh, look at you! You're so beautiful!

Finley thrashes about in the net, his scales glinting in the sunlight.

CUT TO:

INT. JEN'S CAR - DAY

Jen carefully places Finley in a specialized container filled with water, and they set off towards a nearby hill. As they drive, the sky begins to darken, and the air grows thick with an otherworldly energy.

CUT TO:

EXT. HILL - DAY

Jen and Finley arrive at the hill, and she carefully removes the lid from the container. Finley is released, and he swims around the container, disoriented.

JEN
(smiling)
Okay, buddy, it's time to see something amazing!

Finley swims closer to the edge of the container, and Jen points to the sky.

CUT TO:

EXT. HILL - DAY

The sky darkens, and a solar eclipse begins to take place. Finley's eyes widen in terror as the moon blocks the sun's light.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(whispering)
What...what is this? A...a...a void? A...a...a... (gulps) a...a...a... (stammers)

Jen watches in awe as Finley's eyes grow wider, his fins trembling with fear.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(whispering)
I...I...I see...things...things that shouldn't be... (gulps) Horrors beyond my comprehension... (stammers)

Finley's monologue becomes more frantic, his words tumbling out in a maddening torrent.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(whispering)
I see...tentacles...writhing...like living shadows... (gulps) Eyes...glowing...with an otherworldly light... (stammers)
I see...forms...shifting...like the very fabric of reality... (gulps) I see...the void...yawning...like an endless chasm... (stammers)

Finley's voice rises to a fevered pitch as he descends into madness.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(whispering)
I...I...I am but a...a...a... (gulps) a...a...a... (stammers) a...a...a... (screams)
I am but a...a...a... (gulps) a...a...a... (stammers) a...a...a... (falls silent)

Jen watches in horror as Finley's eyes roll back in his head, and he collapses onto the container's floor.

CUT TO:

EXT. HILL - DAY

As the eclipse reaches its peak, Finley's body begins to contort and twist, his scales shimmering with an otherworldly energy. Jen backs away, terrified, as Finley's form begins to shift and writhe like a living thing.

FINLEY (V.O.)
(whispering)
I...I...I am... (gulps) I am... (stammers) I am... (falls silent)

The eclipse ends, and the sun reappears, casting a warm glow over the landscape. Finley's body returns to its normal shape, and he lies still, his eyes vacant.

Jen approaches Finley cautiously, her eyes filled with a mix of fear and wonder.

JEN
(whispering)
Finley? Finley, can you hear me?

Finley's eyes flicker, and he blinks slowly.

FINLEY
(whispering)
I...I...I don't know... (gulps) I don't know... (stammers)

Jen looks on, unsure of what to do next, as Finley's eyes seem to hold a deep, existential despair.

FADE TO BLACK.
